title.zh: C10K 问题与 Nginx 440 字节连接槽

description.zh: 一连接一线程在万级并发时先被 8 MiB 默认虚拟栈和上下文切换抖动压垮；Nginx 每核只起一个单线程 Worker，把每条空闲长连接压缩进 440 字节的预分配结构槽位。
description.en: One thread per socket hits the C10K cliff through 8 MiB virtual stack reserves and L1/TLB switch thrashing; Nginx runs one single-threaded worker per core with preallocated 440-byte connection/event slots.

zh: nginx 为什么能抗上万并发
一连接一线程为什么慢

description.zh: Master 进程只管配置、监听套接字与信号分发，SIGHUP 重载时新代 Worker 继承同一监听 FD 接新握手，旧代停止 accept 并将存量请求发完再退出，实现零断连切换。
description.en: The Master owns configuration and listening sockets; on SIGHUP reload, newly forked workers inherit the shared listening FD for new handshakes while old workers stop accepting and drain in-flight responses cleanly.

title.zh: Nginx epoll 事件循环、惊群与 SO_REUSEPORT
title.en: Nginx epoll loop, thundering herd & SO_REUSEPORT

description.zh: select/poll 每轮 O(N) 扫全表，而 epoll 只弹出 O(活跃) 的就绪链表 rdllist；EPOLLEXCLUSIVE 与 SO_REUSEPORT 则进一步消除了多 Worker 抢 accept 的惊群与锁竞争。
description.en: select/poll scans all O(N) descriptors every tick while epoll pops only O(active) ready events; EPOLLEXCLUSIVE and SO_REUSEPORT remove multi-worker thundering-herd wakeups and shared queue locks.

title.zh: Nginx 请求 11 阶段状态机与 location 优先级

description.zh: HTTP 请求沿 ngx_http_phases 定义的 11 个固定阶段流转；location 匹配按 = 精确 > 最长前缀带 ^~ 阻断正则 > 配置文件顺序的首条 ~ / ~* 正则 > 最长前缀兜底裁决。
description.en: Requests flow through 11 fixed ngx_http_phases; location matching resolves by = exact > longest prefix carrying ^~ > first matching ~ / ~* regex in file order > longest prefix fallback.

title.zh: ngx_pool_t 按请求内存池与缓冲区链
title.en: Per-request ngx_pool_t memory pool & buffer chains

description.zh: Nginx 为每个请求建 4 KiB 内存池，小块通过对齐推进 d.last 指针 O(1) 分配、超限才落 pool->large，请求结束时一次 ngx_destroy_pool() 整块回收以杜绝堆碎片。
description.en: Nginx gives each request a 4 KiB ngx_pool_t arena for O(1) bump allocation via d.last, offloading oversized chunks to pool->large and freeing everything in one ngx_destroy_pool() call.

title.zh: 平滑加权轮询（SWRR）均衡算法

description.zh: ngx_http_upstream_get_peer 每轮加有效权重并从赢家减去总权重，保持 sum(current_weight) 恒为零，把 {5,1,1} 的突发连打抹平为 [A, A, B, A, C, A, A]。
description.en: ngx_http_upstream_get_peer adds effective_weight each turn and subtracts total weight from the selected peer, keeping sum(current_weight)=0 and smoothing {5,1,1} into [A, A, B, A, C, A, A].

zh: 加权轮询为什么不连发

title.zh: limit_req 共享内存漏桶限流

description.zh: ngx_http_limit_req_lookup 在跨进程共享内存红黑树里按毫秒匀速漏水，以 burst 控制队列或 nodelay 直通上限，超限返 503 且不抬高桶水位。
description.en: ngx_http_limit_req_lookup tracks millisecond leaky-bucket excess in a shared-memory rbtree, pacing requests up to burst or forwarding immediately with nodelay while returning 503 on overflow.

title.zh: 红黑树定时器与 300 毫秒懒更新
title.en: Red-black timer tree & 300 ms lazy updates

description.zh: 所有连接超时按键值放入 ngx_event_timer_rbtree，最左节点直接决定 epoll_wait 睡眠时长，300 ms 懒更新阈值则免去高频小包下的大量红黑树旋转。
description.en: All socket deadlines live in ngx_event_timer_rbtree where the leftmost node sets epoll_wait's timeout and NGX_TIMER_LAZY_DELAY (300 ms) skips redundant tree updates.

title.zh: sendfile 零拷贝与 proxy_buffering 解耦

description.zh: 静态资源靠 sendfile() + TCP_CORK 从内核页缓存直达网卡跳过用户态（无 kTLS 时 HTTPS 会回退）；反向代理则反过来用 proxy_buffering 接住响应以防慢客户端拖死后端。
description.en: Static serving uses sendfile() + TCP_CORK to DMA straight from the kernel page cache (falling back under non-kTLS HTTPS), while proxy_buffering absorbs responses so slow clients never pin backend workers.

title.zh: QUIC 热重载、Pingora 与 Envoy 架构演进

description.zh: Nginx 1.28/1.30/1.31 持续打磨 HTTP/3 QUIC 与不丢连接的 quic_bpf 热重载，而 Cloudflare Pingora 和 Envoy 则分别转向多线程全局共享连接池与线程本地架构。
description.en: Nginx 1.28/1.30/1.31 mature HTTP/3 QUIC and seamless quic_bpf reloads, while Cloudflare Pingora and Envoy adopt multi-threaded globally shared pools and thread-local data planes.
